narr: Thunderstorms developed along the higher terrain to the north and moved towards the area. As storms moved into a highly unstable environment, they became more widespread and produced damaging winds, small hail, and flash flooding.
ev: Dispatch reported flooding in many locations in the Beech Island community, blocking roadways. A car stalled in floodwaters on Sand Bar Ferry Rd and Urquhart Dr. Water entered a power plant along Urquhart Dr while a digital rain gage at the plant record 4.5 inches of rain in an hour.
lsr: SHERIFF DISPATCH REPORTED FLOODING IN MANY LOCATIONS IN THE BEECH ISLAND COMMUNITY. A CAR HYDROPLANED AND THEN STALLED ON SAND BAR FERRY ROAD AND URQUHART DRIVE.
